name: Team Charmander: Sevii Pyre Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago traversal — Electric/Psychic speed sweeping, Ice fortress coverage, Fighting/Ground wallbreaking, Intimidate pivoting, and Thick Fat sponge.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym battle in Chapter 18. All six party members train and travel together in full 6-member route configuration, exploring Knot Island, Treasure Beach, Kindle Road, and Mt. Ember under the Level 72 cap.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 72. Sleep Powder neutralizes dangerous wild threats instantly. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Bug and Grass encounters, while Petal Dance melts Water types.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt vaporizes Kindle Road and Treasure Beach water spawns (Tentacruel, Gyarados). Psychic cleanly executes Fighting martial artists.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 71. Hydro Pump douses Mt. Ember's volcanic Rock and Fire spawns with massive super-effective force.
477 BST physical wallbreaker. STAB Earthquake crushes Mt. Ember's Magmar and Team Rocket's Poison hybrids. Close Combat shatters Rock types effortlessly.
522 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts physical Attack on entry. STAB Aqua Tail washes away fire and ground foes. Megahorn counters Grass and Psychic switch-ins.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire attacks on Mt. Ember. RestTalk loop provides infinite sustain across long island route traversal.

flex_bench.rationale: High-speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind team acceleration and Roost sustain.
Ground-immune physical wall packing Sludge Bomb and Will-O-Wisp for burn suppression.
Iron Fist-boosted elemental punches provide custom super-effective physical coverage.
